deadEnd.details: Cloudflare WAF serves 'Sorry, you have been blocked' (HTTP 403 block page with a Ray ID, no challenge to solve) on the homepage and on /booking for the proxy's patchright Chrome session from a residential/local egress. Seen on two separate runs (earlier HTTP 403, rechecked 2026-10-02). May be egress-dependent; recheck from a different egress before treating as permanent.

gotchas: The Cloudflare block is a hard WAF block page, not a Turnstile/CAPTCHA: there is nothing to hand off, and retrying from the same IP only reinforces the block.
Both https://www.allegiantair.com/ and https://www.allegiantair.com/booking return the block page, so no search, fare, or payment selectors could be gathered.
